title: How much of a QR code can be damaged?

probes.question: What kind of error correction do QR codes use?
True or false: how well a damaged level H code scans depends on where the damage is.

image.alt: A black-and-white QR code on a white background.

body.question: A QR code gets scuffed. At the highest error-correction level, about how much of its data can be restored?
body.reveal: QR codes use Reed-Solomon error correction. Level H can theoretically restore about 30% of the codewords. In practice it depends on where the damage is, because the corner finder patterns must survive.
